name: Jet Plastics
old_description: Founded in 1948, Jet Plastics is one of the pioneers in the plastics industry.  Emerging from the need for plastics in the developing aerospace industry after the Second World War, we have established a tradition of innovation and service.  As we eagerly move forward, we are confident and determined to maintain our traditions and continue to build on our rich history.
about:
Jet Plastics was founded in 1948 in Los Angeles, California, emerging from the demand for plastic components in the post‑World War II aerospace sector. The company began as a pioneer in the plastics industry, establishing a tradition of innovation and service that has continued for over seven decades.

The company specializes in custom plastic profile extrusion, injection molding, and fabrication, supported by in‑house tool making and secondary operations. These capabilities allow Jet Plastics to produce a wide range of plastic parts and profiles from raw material through finished components at its Los Angeles facility.

While its roots lie in aerospace, Jet Plastics serves a broad base of industrial customers requiring custom plastic extrusions and molded parts. The company also operates an online store offering stock products for direct purchase.

Jet Plastics emphasizes its deep experience, noting that there is "very little we have not seen" in the plastics industry, and aims to maintain its traditions of innovation and service as it moves forward.
